one_line: A named parenting fear in the first line, the book on screen at 0:01, then a buyer's real objection answered out loud.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 selfie at eye level, a dark object at her lips. Said and subtitled: "אם גם אתם פוחדים מהגמילה מחיתולים". 0:01 full-screen cut to the illustrated child in a garden (the cover art), 0:03 back to her: "עשיתי משהו שלא חשבתי שיעבוד".
q1_hook.why: Names a fear only potty-training parents have, so the right viewer self-selects in one line (H1). A person speaking from frame one helps early retention (H4), and the hook is said and subtitled at once (H6). "Something I didn't think would work" opens a gap the Reel pays off at 0:18 (H5). The cover at 0:01 shows the result before the explanation (H2).

beats.what: Selfie hook, cut to the cover art at 0:01
beats.why: Problem plus a promise, product already on screen

beats.what: Top-down hand on printed spreads; "I was sceptical"
beats.why: Admitting doubt makes the later praise easier to believe

beats.what: Mother and child reading on a sofa, ordering-site screen recording as an overlay; "I uploaded one photo"
beats.why: Shows how easy it is without stopping the story

beats.what: Child's smiling face close to the lens
beats.why: A burst of joy keeps attention through the explanation

beats.what: Child recognises the cover; "זאת באמת היא"
beats.why: Pays off the opening promise: it looks like her

beats.what: Reading on the sofa, editor overlay; "she saw herself in the story"
beats.why: Emotional reason to buy, not a feature list
Re-hooks mid-Reel with the question a buyer actually has

beats.what: Hand turning pages; fast arrival, other options checked, quality, price, add family or a pet
beats.why: Five reasons in 13 s; the densest and slowest stretch

beats.what: Child reading, then a page close-up; "I'm not saying it's magic"
beats.why: Honest close, no CTA on screen

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "ספרו לי בתגובות מה הסיפור שהכי מתאים לילד.ה שלכם?". The video itself asks nothing; the delivery-time line invites a reply but does not ask for one.
q2_flow.why: A sceptic-to-surprised arc with a payoff at 0:18 holds attention (K2, H5), and the spoken objection at 0:29 restarts curiosity (R3). The 0:34 to 0:47 list of reasons over similar page flips is information without a new feeling, the stretch most likely to lose viewers (R3, R1). The caption question is specific and answerable from a parent's life (R6, C5).

q3_cta.what: None in the video. Caption: a discount code ("שוהם2026"), the question "ספרו לי בתגובות...", and the @lumebookai tag. No comment word, no link.
q3_cta.why: Two different asks (use a code, answer a question) sit only in the caption, and the video ends on the caveat with nothing said or shown (against C1 and C6). A viewer convinced at 0:53 has no next step on screen. The question itself is a good comment prompt (C5).

q4_shown.what: The cover art at 0:01; printed spreads under her hand from 0:04; the ordering site as a semi-transparent overlay 0:11 to 0:27; her toddler holding, pointing at and reading the book; page close-ups to the end. No price, no photo of the child beside the illustration.
q4_shown.why: The book is handled within 2 s and stays in use throughout (S1). The making-of overlay shows the personalising step (S8) and a parent vouches in her own words (S6). The proof of likeness is only her claim and the cover; a photo beside the page would settle the main doubt (S2). The child's face and name on screen is what LumeBook's own Reels should avoid (S5).

q5_edit.what: About 16 shots in 53 s, about 3.3 s each; three cuts in the first 4 s, then 3 to 7 s shots alternating page close-ups and family footage. Voiceover nearly wall to wall, subtitles synced line by line. Screen overlays 0:11 to 0:27. Ends on a page close-up with no end card.
q5_edit.why: A fast open then a steady cut every few seconds fits the moderate pace that holds attention (E1, E2). Voice carries the message with synced subtitles for muted viewers (E4). The overlay plus subtitles crowds the frame for 16 s (T2). The Reel ends right after the last line with no dead tail (E8), but at 53 s it is long for its message (R2).

q6_topic.what: A potty-training worry, and a personalised book as a gentle help; the caption reframes it as a second-birthday gift.
q6_topic.why: A real parenting worry and a "you're not alone" tone match what parents seek on social media (K6). The milestone is a buying moment (K7). Her honest "not magic" keeps the claim modest (K4). The birthday caption on a potty video splits the topic, so neither moment lands fully.

q7_filmed.what: Handheld selfie for the hook; handheld top-down hand on pages; a static wide shot of mother and toddler on a sofa (phone propped); over-the-shoulder close-ups of the child reading. Daylight and warm lamp light at home.
q7_filmed.why: Home, phone and real moments give the native creator look (H8, F7). Top-down hands on the pages put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5). Talking to the lens in the hook speaks to "you" (F6). The wide sofa shot makes the book small, so the overlay has to do the explaining (F4).

q8_text.on_screen: Burned-in white subtitles of every spoken line, no box, about 80% down the frame: "אם גם אתם פוחדים מהגמילה מחיתולים" (0:00), "הקטע הכי הזוי?" (0:12), "זה יגיע בזמן?" larger at 0:33. Ordering-site overlays in the lower left 0:11 to 0:27, mostly unreadable. No headline card, no CTA text.
q8_text.caption: "הבטחתי לכם המלצה על מתנות שוות ליומולדת שנתיים". About 165 words: gift framing, topics list, the discount code, a question, a UGC disclosure in the second-to-last paragraph, 5 hashtags.
q8_text.why: Subtitling every line makes it work muted (T1), but the subtitles sit inside the bottom 35% where Reels buttons and the caption cover them (T4, F2). The caption's first line is about birthdays, not the video's hook (T7). The disclosure is honest but hidden below "more" (T8).

weak_points: Text and overlays crowding the frame 0:11 to 0:27; subtitles in the bottom band; no CTA on screen; caption topic (birthday) different from the video (potty); disclosure below the fold; a 13 s list of reasons over similar shots.
lumebook_takeaway: Keep the skeleton: worry line with the book at 0:01, a short screen recording of the preview, one objection answered. Swap the child shots for page flips and a photo-beside-page shot.
not_verified: What the object at her lips is. Music (not evident). Whether LumeBook supplied or edited the video. Watch time and saves are unavailable.
